message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t give you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/ and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **AQICN** | Go to https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/ for a live map and hourly updates. |
| **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or your phone’s weather widget) | Many include an AQI indicator. |
| **Local news** | TV or online outlets often report on smog levels during high‑pollution events. |

If you’re planning outdoor activities, a quick look at one of those sites will tell you whether the AQI is “Good,” “Moderate,” “Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups,” etc., and whether you should take precautions.
